lines.1: The school gate was about to close.
lines.2: 「...Made it. That sprint was worth it.」
lines.4: 「Leave home with more time to spare.」
lines.7: 「Do not blame each other. It is ugly.」
lines.15: 「Look at you, actually greeting us. Did that thick skull finally learn how society works?」
lines.17: Yashi turned up her nose and walked off.
lines.18: 「Yashi at least dresses impeccably. Learn from her.」
lines.20: 「What is it? Something on your mind?」
lines.22: I didn't think she'd ever greeted us first before.
lines.23: Maybe our teamwork had improved a little.
lines.25: 「Student council activities begin now. This is our first work after camp, so let's fully demonstrate that foreign word, teamwork.」
lines.26: 「Hear that, Coconut? Don't hold me back.」
lines.27: 「...Hm? Where is that voice coming from? It's too low to see.」
lines.32: They glared at each other and actually went outside.
lines.34: 「Teacher is exhausted. Learning I get no comp time has left me five seconds from depression...」
lines.35: Inori sprawled limply across the sofa.
lines.37: 「You spent class with her today. She's already back to normal. See?」
lines.39: Oh, she really was. Thank goodness.
lines.41: The council corps scattered in every direction.
lines.42: They really knew how to play along.
lines.44: 「Good work. That's all for today. We'll be back tomorrow, so see you then.」
lines.51: 「Hey, Coconut. We're going to the arcade. Wanna come?」
lines.52: Oh. Look at her being friendly.
lines.53: 「I'll drag you onto my home turf, beat you, and violate your spirit.」
lines.56: 「Tch. You're as antisocial as ever. I wanted to pound you in a fighting game.」
lines.58: For Yashi, simply saying goodbye might count as progress.
lines.59: 「Well, everyone. Shall we cheerfully prepare for the Sports and Martial Arts Festival?」
lines.60: 「Um, before that, we have a visitor... Cooking Club president Yang Tonfa.」
lines.65: 「I see. The cooking club lacks members for the festival.」
lines.68: 「Yoppi, you may establish yourself as the exposition character.」
lines.71: 「Ryuumeikan's famous Sports and Martial Arts Festival is a huge two-day event. It's a local attraction big enough for local TV stations to come.」
lines.73: 「The cooking club serves all the visitors Dragon Soup.」
lines.75: 「It's like kenchin soup. It's quietly famous, too.」
lines.76: 「Food for everyone? That is a serious operation.」
lines.77: 「A shortage hurts. You should have told us sooner.」
lines.81: 「I understand. You want us to find a helper who can cook and contribute immediately.」
lines.82: 「Princess understands. Only need one. I rushed here hoping student council find good cook.」
lines.84: 「Sounds like a pain, so I'll pass. Even if Tonfa asked.」
lines.86: 「What the hell! I'll ring your doorbell and run!」
lines.87: 「Don't suggest pranks even elementary kids have outgrown.」
lines.89: 「Yeah, meals make you think of Subaru.」
lines.91: 「It's the only school event where Subaru shines.」
lines.92: 「I can't tell whether that's praise or an insult.」
lines.93: 「Better than some people who never shine.」
lines.96: 「...Just checking, you don't mean me, right?」
lines.100: 「We cannot put Dragon Cup favorite Subaru behind the scenes. He must enliven the event.」
lines.103: 「Yoppi and I will represent the council and support the athletics committee that day. Unfortunately, we have no time.」
lines.105: 「What, Yoppi? You think your skills would be enough to help?」
lines.112: 「Fukahire, your punishment for troubling Yoppi is cleaning duty.」
lines.114: 「My orders outweigh the Supreme Court. No appeals.」
lines.116: 「They don't call me Princess for nothing.」
lines.117: 「You brought it on yourself. You always act tough around weak or kind people.」
lines.125: 「No danger there. I would never recommend you, Otome.」
lines.129: She really kept herself detached from everything.
lines.135: 「Help the cooking club. You're good at cooking.」
lines.137: 「Will the council manage without Yashi, Princess?」
lines.138: 「Well, Nagomin is capable, so it'll sting a little. But we'll manage. We don't assign vital work to a brand-new first-year.」
lines.139: 「There you go. Don't worry about us.」
lines.141: 「But you're qualified. Your lunch was delicious.」
lines.142: 「I'd like to try the Dragon Soup you make.」
lines.144: 「We talked a little at camp and now you're getting carried away, aren't you?」
lines.146: 「I'm talking about our duty as council members.」
lines.147: 「I said I'm not doing it. Quit hounding me, asshole.」
lines.149: 「My, my. Did you hear that, executive director?」
lines.150: 「Delinquent speech in this day and age, president.」
lines.151: 「I came here as a temporary substitute, but nobody has ever arrived to replace me.」
lines.152: 「Still talking about a replacement? Cold. We went to camp together.」
lines.153: 「I only went because even as a substitute, joining the council gave me that responsibility.」
lines.154: 「You had fun. And sometimes a substitute stays in the whole game, right?」
lines.155: 「So I was never a substitute. I was your real choice from the start.」
lines.156: 「No, it was true. If you'd been useless, I would have cut you mercilessly.」
lines.157: 「Fine, then use this chance to join the council for real.」
lines.159: 「Oh, I forgot. I already registered you for real.」
lines.161: 「Of course. I never let capable people escape.」
lines.162: 「Whether I'm a council member or not, I refuse this cooking-club request.」
lines.164: Yashi wheeled around and left the council room.
lines.166: For some reason, the Princess smiled in genuine delight.
lines.170: 「But that's by our standards. Everyone has different forbidden words.」
lines.171: 「I thought I chose my words carefully instead of getting swept up in the mood.」
lines.173: 「Wait, why do you know how well Coconut cooks?」
lines.174: 「When you stole my lunch, she shared some of hers.」
lines.175: I ground my knuckles into her temples.
lines.176: 「Ow, ow! Gaaah... I shouldn't have asked.」
lines.177: 「So, are you chasing her, young man?」
